root_cause.text: The `ib_del_sub_device_and_put` function in the RDMA core subsystem caused a reference count leak by failing to release the device reference acquired by the caller when returning `-EOPNOTSUPP` due to a missing parent device.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces `ib_device_put(sub);` inside the `if (!parent)` block before returning `-EOPNOTSUPP`, addressing the CVE description which states that `nldev_deldev()` acquires a reference via `ib_device_get_by_index()` before calling this function and requires it to be dropped on error.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix reference leak by adding ib_device_put(sub) call in the error path when parent is null.
intent_record.what: Wrapped the if (!parent) condition block in braces and inserted ib_device_put(sub) before the return statement.
intent_record.how: Ensures the reference count of the sub device is decremented when the parent device is missing, preventing a resource leak.
